properties.displayName: Azure Kubernetes Service Private Clusters should be enabled
properties.description: Enable the private cluster feature for your Azure Kubernetes Service cluster to ensure network traffic between your API server and your node pools remains on the private network only. This is a common requirement in many regulatory and industry compliance standards. Enabled=true checks all matching in-scope resources; false skips the check.

metadata.description: Start in audit mode. Only effects supported by the source definition are available.
True checks every matching resource within the assignment scope; false skips the check. Use assignment exclusions or exemptions for exceptions. Select true or false; defaults to true.
